services.desc: Adventure is calling your name - get after it! Tandem skydiving is a no-experience-necessary way to spread your wings and soar. Show up, get trained, head up, and then fly down! It’s the best option for your first-time skydiving. So what are you waiting for? Skydive NEPA is just a short drive from Scranton, PA and Binghamton, NY and is the top choice for tandem skydiving in Northeast PA. Adventure awaits! Fly over the breathtaking Endless Mountains in Northeastern Pennsylvania with one of our professional tandem instructors.
